Approved rationale, exact 30-slice order, verification cadence, preservation boundary, rollback units, and mandatory human checkpoints

allowedWork: Animation conformance, equation grammar v2, typed policy registries, provenance, review freshness, equation-family migrations, log-equivalence repair, and derivative recompilation described by the approved proposal
Family-sized compatibility deletion and stable verification tooling directly required by the approved migrations
disallowedWork: New animation families, public lesson layout, material-depth experiments, universal renderers, live LLM generation, broad non-equation renderer migrations, and unrelated dirty work
goal: Make animation principles retroactive and enforceable through one conformance gateway and a fully converged equation grammar v2, then return the derivative exemplar for review
commitCadence: Commit every independently reversible verified slice with exact path staging and completed Theseus evidence; emit loop status at starts, completions, commit boundaries, and stops.
stopConditions: Stop at slice 22 for mandatory human review; do not promote calibration aesthetics without approval.

slices.title: inventory
slices.summary: Generated and verified static inventory for all 58 loadable assets; exposed 43 equation governance bypasses and repaired Lisp adapter capability selection.

slices.title: baselines
slices.summary: Recorded current inference, bundle, lazy-loading, focused verification, and runtime baselines without raising ceilings or leaving persistent processes. Inference debt is explicit and quarantined; bundle and runtime regression checks pass.

slices.title: principle-ledger
slices.summary: Added a typed principle ledger whose enforcement is derived from lifecycle status. Only evidence-backed principles with two distinct exemplars and contract IDs are required; single-exemplar visual discoveries remain advisory, and deprecated or blocked records carry no implicit global authority.

slices.title: conformance-manifest
slices.summary: Generated one renderer-neutral conformance manifest for each of 58 loadable assets. Manifests expose semantic authority, projection, deterministic clock, legacy policy epoch, capabilities, review provenance, and typed compatibility gaps without DOM, CSS, coordinates, or renderer resources.

slices.title: policy-epochs
slices.summary: Added immutable legacy and governance-v2 preview policy epochs plus deterministic profile provenance. Legacy implicit behavior remains reproducible; declared profiles carry stable structural fingerprints; the v2 preview rejects implicit equation profiles rather than inheriting mutable defaults.

slices.title: review-freshness
slices.summary: Added fail-closed current, stale-by-policy, stale-by-renderer, unreviewed, and waived review states. Only an explicit snapshot matching the exact policy, profiles, and renderer adapters can be current; legacy provenance remains visible but stale.

slices.title: reverse-dependencies
slices.summary: Generated a structured reverse dependency graph from manifest-declared principles, motifs, renderers, and typography profiles. Dependency changes now return exact affected asset and review sets without treating import scans or string search as authority.

slices.title: registration-gateway
slices.summary: Integrated the common conformance gateway into lazy catalogue loading. Every carried asset resolves to generated manifest metadata or an explicit typed gap before use; undeclared assets fail closed, composite child ownership remains valid, and bundle boundaries still pass.

slices.title: equation-grammar-v2
slices.summary: Defined and compiler-branded kp.equation-grammar.v2. It requires per-transition semantic operation, correspondence, projection, typography policy, teaching intent, pinned operation packs, governance-v2 epoch, and one clock; it rejects caller timing, paths, display mode, and asset-wide operation defaults. Inference stayed exactly at baseline.

slices.title: transition-resolution
slices.summary: Resolved each v2 equation transition through pinned canonical operation packs under one host clock; unknown operations and pin failures now yield typed repair states, while asset defaults remain explicit legacy compatibility only.

slices.title: evaluation-registry
slices.summary: Made evaluation a declared semantic class and added one mandatory renderer-neutral authority registry covering product, quotient, difference, sum, cancellation, identity, and successor formation. Registered evaluations cannot masquerade as generic transforms; unregistered evaluations fail to typed repair; callers cannot author family, timing, or generic-fade behavior.

slices.title: projection-choreography
slices.summary: Added registered replacement, equivalence, and derivation representation topologies. Projection records reuse exact resolved semantic operation objects, add occurrence and paint-ownership obligations without coordinates or timing, and fail closed on missing profiles or cross-grammar operation resolution.

slices.title: typography-policy
slices.summary: Separated equation typography into registered flow, TeX mathStyle, and optical scale dimensions. Large operators now require semantic entity/kind/limit-placement declarations and a compatible policy; a global displayMode switch is absent and cannot stand in for typography intent.

slices.title: katex-endpoints
slices.summary: Added semantic typography-parametric Native KaTeX v2 endpoints, exact SSR/client hydration identity, and mandatory typography invalidation in compositor geometry caches; existing sessions now declare legacy profile keys explicitly.

slices.title: transit-obligations
slices.summary: Compiled semantic relation-clearance and target-cohort intents into branded obligations. Moving records now require renderer-measured routes and registered timing; arrivals settle against native target ink before ownership, while invalid entities, duplicate cohorts, and caller paths or timing fail closed.

slices.title: route-certificates
slices.summary: Added nominal renderer-session measured-route certificates over the existing dense collision compiler. Certification requires one measurement revision, explicit semantic bindings, relation clearance without overlap waivers, exact endpoint settlement, and exclusive paint occurrences; later sampling is pure and rejects copied authority.

slices.title: compiled-presentation-plan
slices.summary: Added one nominal equation presentation-plan compiler that resolves operations, mandatory evaluations, projection, typography, and transit from grammar v2. It preserves exact authority identity, one clock, generic adapter consumption, and typed semantic domain payloads while rejecting universal pose or caller presentation data.

slices.title: architecture-ratchets
slices.summary: Added an equation-governance v2 source gate: opted-in callers cannot own measured routes, timing, display mode, CSS clocks, evaluation resolution, or lower-layer compilation. Exact owners remain explicit, legacy debt is inventoried until migration, and graph/code/3D sources are demonstrably excluded.

slices.title: log-occurrences
slices.summary: Compiled explicit renderer-neutral occurrence identity for the log-product equivalence: one retained witness, one equality, one derived provenance copy per factor, and one native target. Binary and multi-factor shapes derive from canonical correspondence, and every retained/derived/target occurrence has distinct paint identity without changing timing or routes.

slices.title: log-paint-ownership
slices.summary: Compiled and applied equivalence-specific paint ownership. The left witness remains frozen native paint; source ln and shell tracks retain compositor accounting but are sampled permanently invisible; only factor clones and introduced right-side syntax paint live; and the material scene settles before one native-target handoff. Browser checks reject duplicate or blank paint across seek, rewind, reduced motion, and narrow layouts.
